0022600042.text: The Clippers (2-8, 2-3 at home, 0-5 on the road) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, 5-0 at home) in LA's 11th game of the season, with the Clippers 13th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 7 games back, and both teams enter on a one-game losing streak. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury, while the Thunder are missing Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Clippers trail this season's series 0-1 after a 108-101 loss in Oklahoma City on October 25, and they lost all three meetings with the Thunder in 2025-26.
